meta.project: ATM-Expert — Intelligent ATM Fault Diagnosis & Advisory System
meta.description: 200 benchmark ATM fault scenarios for inference engine evaluation
meta.usage: Each scenario contains 'facts' (normalised ATM state facts) to be injected into the inference engine's working memory. The 'expected_diagnosis', 'expected_severity', and 'expected_resolution' fields are the ground-truth labels for accuracy evaluation.
